## Summary

```text
Grouping selection
  reject proven product-prefix duplicates before typed suffix resolution
  refuse unsafe dtplyr full-join metadata dispatch before caller code
  resolve custom stringr pattern dispatch against typed metadata
```

Closes #1341
Closes #1342
Closes #1344

## Evidence

- **Before:** a masked full join could silently remove a character grouping key; a multi-set suffix could run predicates or acquire metadata before a proven duplicate error; standard pattern methods could receive integer name placeholders and falsely fail length validation.
  **After:** proven product duplicates reject before typed selectors or metadata; unsafe full-join dispatch refuses before caller bindings; pattern methods receive typed selection data while stock patterns retain the name-only path. Public controls preserve grain, occurrence IDs, payloads and caller input.
- TDD: #1341 `b16b9804`, #1342 `e24c539f` with follow-up offset/resource controls, #1344 `59e80a9c`; local and backend tests are separated by optional-backend policy.
- Independent combined-boundary replay passes on integrated `1abccf39b58b0becf0ea77c9a58c0e7b622db38e`: duplicate refusal precedes custom pattern and masked merge calls (both zero), safe typed metadata preserves the character key, and caller input remains unchanged.
- Verification: [final full Review-ready at 8b20ddf2 — 0 ERROR, 0 WARNING, 0 NOTE; timing disposition complete](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/pull/1352#issuecomment-6660726540).
- Review: [Standards and Spec, including the accepted P2 repair and final-SHA follow-up](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/pull/1352#issuecomment-6660760257): 0 unresolved findings.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

The changes can be reverted without a migration.

**Blast Radius:** Grouping

Grouping preflight, typed selector classification, and dtplyr metadata safety across inspection and Margin verbs.
